name: audit-deploy-pack
description: Audit pre-deploy modulare per progetti web. Stack-aware (PHP/Laravel/Node/Python/Go), DB-aware (MySQL/Postgres/SQLite/Mongo), hosting-aware (Netsons/Aruba/SiteGround/Vercel/Railway/AWS). 10 skill granulari invocabili singolarmente (audit-security, audit-seo, ecc.) o tramite orchestrator audit-deploy. Pipeline a 3 fasi con gestione intelligente dei modelli (Haiku pre-check, Sonnet audit parallelo, Haiku scoring) e ciclo iterativo di fix con approval gate sui finding critici.
